panels.title: Wraparound risk — top-N tables (drill down to specific tables)

panels.description: Top-N tables driving the database-level XID wraparound clock — `age(pg_class.relfrozenxid)`. Lines climbing here mean specific tables are not getting frozen; a single laggard can dominate the database `datfrozenxid`. Threshold reference lines at `autovacuum_freeze_max_age` (200M) and the failsafe range (1.6B+).

url_options.data:
WITH q AS (
SELECT labels, t, value
FROM prom_topk((CAST(${top_n:sqlstring} AS BIGINT)), 'last_over_time', ('pgwatch_table_stats_tx_freeze_age'), ([['cluster', '=', ${cluster_name:sqlstring}], ['node_name', '=', ${node_name:sqlstring}], ['datname', '=~', '${db_name:regex}'], ['schema', '!~', 'pg_.*|information_schema|_timescaledb.*']]),
       (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), (300000::BIGINT))
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, coalesce(q.labels['schema'], '') || '.' || coalesce(q.labels['table_name'], '') AS series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

WITH q AS (
SELECT t, value FROM (
  SELECT t, max(value) AS value
  FROM prom_last_over_time(('pgwatch_pg_settings_wraparound_autovacuum_freeze_max_age'),
         [['cluster','=',(${cluster_name:sqlstring})],['node_name','=',(${node_name:sqlstring})]],
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), 300000)
  GROUP BY t)
WHERE NOT (false) OR value > 0
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'autovacuum_freeze_max_age (soft)' AS series, '' AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

WITH q AS (
SELECT t, value FROM (
  SELECT t, max(value) AS value
  FROM prom_last_over_time(('pgwatch_pg_settings_wraparound_vacuum_failsafe_age'),
         [['cluster','=',(${cluster_name:sqlstring})],['node_name','=',(${node_name:sqlstring})]],
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), 300000)
  GROUP BY t)
WHERE NOT (true) OR value > 0
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'vacuum_failsafe_age (failsafe)' AS series, '' AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

WITH q AS (
SELECT unnest(range((CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)) + 1, (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))) AS t,
       CAST((2137483648::BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) AS value
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'XID exhaustion (read-only)' AS series, '' AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top-N tables by XID age (relfrozenxid)

panels.description: Top-N tables driving the database-level MultiXID wraparound clock — `mxid_age(pg_class.relminmxid)`. New per-table metric `pgwatch_table_stats_mxid_freeze_age` (added alongside `tx_freeze_age` in `table_stats`). Threshold reference lines: `autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age` (soft, 400M default), `vacuum_multixact_failsafe_age` (failsafe, PG14+ only, hidden when 0), and a static ~2^31 − 10M hard limit (cluster refuses new MultiXIDs).

WITH q AS (
WITH a AS (

), b AS (
  SELECT labels, t, greatest(value, CAST((1::BIGINT) AS DOUBLE)) AS value
  FROM prom_last(('pgwatch_pg_autovacuum_workers_max_workers'), ([['cluster', '=', ${cluster_name:sqlstring}], ['node_name', '=', ${node_name:sqlstring}]]),
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))
